PRICE PRIORS for recurring line types (statistical model fitted on the thresholds t revealed
in earlier games; gross amounts). How to use them:
- The amounts are final thresholds as they were revealed: they already contain whatever
  deductible, VAT and customary-price judgement applied in those cases, and they were computed
  from the full invoiced quantity (the whole quantity was indemnified there). For an
  indemnified line of this type take the stated amount for the line as t as it stands and give
  a price_log_sd that matches the stated range. Do not deduct a deductible from it and do not
  cut the invoiced quantity.
- Deviate only for something this case has and those cases did not: an aggregate cap or
  sub-limit that the lines of this invoice must share, a percentage reduction for a breached
  duty, or a purchase price or sum insured stated in the claim that limits the line.
- Whether a line is indemnified in THIS case is decided by the policy and the claim, not by
  the history. The history only says how often this line type was paid at all. A line type
  that was never indemnified before is usually an ancillary charge the policies do not carry;
  treat it as indemnified only if this policy clearly says so.
- line 2 "Vehicle costs": indemnified in 12 of 26 earlier cases, t = 0 in 14; when indemnified t per unit about 81 (80% range 73 to 88); revealed per unit: >=76 (case 21), >=76 (case 21), >=76 (case 21), >=74 (case 27), >=83 (case 34), >=76 (case 34)
- line 6 "Installer hours": no earlier line of this grade; level of the other hourly grades; when indemnified t per hr about 63 (80% range 23 to 176)
- line 8 "Service technician hours": indemnified in the one earlier case; when indemnified t per hr about 47 (80% range 36 to 69); revealed per hr: 44-49 (case 21), so this line (9 hr) about 425 (327 to 621)
- line 9 "Vehicle costs": indemnified in 12 of 26 earlier cases, t = 0 in 14; when indemnified t per pc about 81 (80% range 73 to 88); revealed per pc: >=76 (case 21), >=76 (case 21), >=76 (case 21), >=74 (case 27), >=83 (case 34), >=76 (case 34)

items.description: Painting the disturbed wall area and closing the wall opening
items.rationale: Repair of the affected wall area after a covered escape of water event is indemnified under 7.1.5 and 7.1.7. Only the disturbed area is covered, not the whole room. Reference Case 36 (cleaning/repainting affected areas) and Case 27 (drying and repair of affected wall/floor).
Policy 7.1.7(f): one travel/call-out charge per contractor per invoice is indemnified. Reference price prior: vehicle costs per unit about 81 (range 73-88).
Consumable installation material used in the repair is covered under 7.1.7(c). Reference Case 27 and 36 (materials for pipe repair).
Replacement pipe for the failed section is covered under 7.1.7(c) and 7.1.5. Only the affected section is indemnified, not any upgrade or extension.
Replacement of insulation removed to access and repair the affected pipe is covered under 7.1.7(c). Only the affected section is indemnified.
Labour for pipe repair is covered under 7.1.7(g). No prior for this exact grade, but similar hourly rates (see price prior for skilled/service technician hours).
Hire or flat-rate deployment of equipment for leak detection or moisture measurement is covered under 7.1.7(e). Reference Case 27 and 36 (moisture measurement, leak detection).
Labour for leak detection, repair, and drying is covered under 7.1.7(g). Price prior: service technician hours per hr about 47 (range 36-69), so 9 hrs ≈ 425.
Policy 7.1.7(f): one travel/call-out charge per contractor per invoice is indemnified. Reference price prior: vehicle costs per unit about 81 (range 73-88).
Drying of the affected area is covered under 7.1.7(b) and (e). Reference Case 36 and 27 (drying unit rental, drying of affected area).
Consumable installation material used in the repair is covered under 7.1.7(c), but reusable tools are not (7.1.8(b)). If this is a disposable blade used up in the repair, it is covered.
Fittings or connectors used in the pipe repair are covered under 7.1.7(c).
If this is a second affected section, covered as above under 7.1.7(c). If duplicate, only one is indemnified (7.1.8(c)), but assume two separate sections unless proven otherwise.
Replacement insulation for the repaired pipe is covered under 7.1.7(c).

If this is a second block of work (e.g., second visit), covered as above. If duplicate, only one is indemnified (7.1.8(c)), but assume two separate visits unless proven otherwise. Price prior: 9 hrs ≈ 425.
